phrases.tip: 开门迎客的第一句。
Welcome to + 地点。

sim: The bathroom is next to your room.
phrases.tip: 近的用 this，远一点的用 that。

sim: Would you like something to drink?
phrases.tip: 回答直接说选择 + please，最自然。

phrases.zh: 好的，谢谢。/ 不用了，谢谢。
phrases.tip: 接受时别只说 Yes，加上 please 才礼貌；拒绝时说 No, thanks。
递东西时说，美国人最常用 Here you go。

phrases.en: Sorry, I don't understand. What's a rug?
phrases.zh: 抱歉，我没听懂。rug 是什么？
phrases.tip: 遇到生词大胆问，美国人通常很乐意解释。

sim: 能用一下你家卫生间吗？
洗手间在哪儿？（公共场所）
phrases.tip: 在别人家用 bathroom，在商场、机场用 restroom。

grammar.title: 物主代词和 's：谁的东西
rows:
my, your, his, her, its, our, their
This is his bedroom. That's their kitchen.

Milo is Linda's cat.
This is Jake's room.
This is my apartment. Its windows are old.
grammar.tip: its（它的）没有撇号；it's = it is。复数名词以 s 结尾时只加 '：my parents' room。
grammar.say: Milo is Linda's cat. This is my parents' bedroom. Its windows are old.

grammar.title: be 的特殊疑问句和简短回答
rows: Where's the bathroom? — It's next to your room.
What's a rug? — It's a small carpet.
How many bedrooms are in the house? — Four.
Is it big? — Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
grammar.tip: 简短回答 Yes, it is. 不能缩写成 Yes, it's.
grammar.say: Where's the bathroom? It's next to your room. Is it big? Yes, it is.

pron.title: 词首的 /k/ 和 /g/
pron.explain: 单词开头的 /k/ 要送气，嘴前放张纸会被吹动，像中文的 k；/g/ 不送气，像中文的 g。coffee、kitchen、cookie、couch 开头都要送气。

readings.title: An email about my home-share
readings.text: Hi Mom and Dad, I'm in my new home now! It's a home-share in Pasadena. The house is on Maple Street. It's big, with four bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a nice kitchen. Three people live in the house: Linda, her son Jake, and me. Linda is a nurse, and Jake is a student at a college here. My bedroom is small, but it's nice. It has a desk, a lamp, and a big window. Oh, and Linda's cat, Milo, is really cute! Love, Wei
readings.zh: 爸妈好，我搬进新家了！是帕萨迪纳的一处合租房，在枫树街上。房子很大，有四间卧室、两个卫生间和一个漂亮的厨房。房子里住三个人：琳达、她儿子杰克和我。琳达是护士，杰克在这儿的一所学院上学。我的卧室不大，但很舒服，有一张书桌、一盏台灯和一扇大窗户。对了，琳达的猫米洛特别可爱！爱你们的，伟

grammarQuiz.q: Jake is Linda's son. This is ___ bedroom.
grammarQuiz.why: 杰克是男生，他的用 his。
单数名字后加 's 表示谁的。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ the bathroom? — It's next to your room.
grammarQuiz.why: 问位置用 Where's。
肯定的简短回答不缩写：Yes, it is.

writingTask.title: 写一封介绍合租房的邮件
writingTask.task: 给家人或朋友写一封邮件，介绍你住的地方：在哪儿、有几个房间、住了几个人、你的房间里有什么。
writingTask.focus: 问号：问句结尾用问号 ?，比如 How are you? / Where is it?
starters: I'm in my new home now!
checklist: 说了房子在哪儿
说了有几个房间、几个人
至少有一个问句，结尾用了问号
用了 my / his / her 等物主代词
writingTask.model: Hi Mom and Dad, how are you? I'm in my new home now! It's a home-share in Pasadena, on Maple Street. It's big, with four bedrooms and two bathrooms. Three people live in the house. My bedroom is small, but it has a desk, a lamp, and a big window. Do you want to see photos? Love, Wei

units.title: I love it
units.zh: 喜好 · 科技 · 音乐
goals: 谈论自己最喜欢的东西
说说怎么使用科技产品
谈论和别人联系的方式

dialogues.title: At the Phone Store
dialogues.zh: 伟在手机店办电话套餐
lines: Yes, I want a phone plan for three months.
是的，我想办一个三个月的电话套餐。
OK. Do you use a lot of data?
Yes, I do. I watch videos and use a lot of apps.
多。我看视频，也用很多应用。
Do you call your family in China?
您给中国的家人打电话吗？
No, I don't. We chat on apps.
Then this plan is good for you. It's thirty dollars a month, with unlimited data.
那这个套餐适合您。每月三十美元，流量不限。
Great. Do you have earphones, too?
Yes, we do. These are very popular. They're great, but they're expensive.
卖。这款很受欢迎，很好，但是贵。
Hmm. I don't want expensive earphones. Just the plan, thanks.
嗯，我不想要贵的耳机。只办套餐就好，谢谢。

dialogues.title: What Music Do You Like?
dialogues.zh: 艾玛和伟聊社交媒体和音乐
lines: Do you post photos on social media?
你在社交媒体上发照片吗？
Yes, I do. I post photos of L.A. for my family. What about you?
发。我发洛杉矶的照片给家人看。你呢？
I don't post a lot. But I listen to music all the time.
我不怎么发。不过我一直在听音乐。
Right. What music do you like?
I love jazz. Chicago has great jazz clubs.
我爱爵士乐。芝加哥有很棒的爵士俱乐部。
Yeah? I like pop music. Do you know any Chinese songs?
是吗？我喜欢流行音乐。你知道中文歌吗？
No, I don't. Play me your favorite song!
不知道。给我放一首你最喜欢的歌吧！
OK. This singer is really famous in China.
好的。这个歌手在中国非常有名。

ex: I chat with my family on an app.
我用一个应用和家人聊天。
Do you have the bank app?
vocab.why: application 来自 apply（应用）+ -ation（名词后缀），手机上就缩短成 app。
vocab.tip: 读 /æp/，嘴张大，不读 /ɑːp/。

ex: I have a good camera on my phone.
vocab.why: Do you have a camera? ## 你有相机吗？
vocab.tip: 来自拉丁语 camera obscura（暗室），早期的相机就是一个暗盒子。

vocab.why: What's your cell phone number? ## 你的手机号是多少？
vocab.tip: 手机网络由蜂窝状的小区（cell）组成。

ex: I listen to music with my earphones.
vocab.why: phone 来自希腊语声音（第 1 单元学过 cell phone）。耳朵上的发声器就是耳机，因为有两只，常用复数。
vocab.tip: 一副耳机：a pair of earphones。

vocab.why: This game is fun. ## 这个游戏很好玩。
vocab.tip: computer 本义是做计算的机器。

ex: I do my homework on my laptop.
我在笔记本电脑上写作业。
我的笔记本电脑很旧了。
我能用一下你的电脑吗？
vocab.why: 可以放在腿上用的电脑。
vocab.tip: 美国人也常直接说 computer。

ex: I don't use my phone a lot.
vocab.why: Can I use your phone? ## 我能用一下你的手机吗？
vocab.tip: telephone 的缩写。

vocab.why: Do you have a smartwatch? ## 你有智能手表吗？
vocab.tip: 聪明的手表。

ex: My son watches videos on his tablet.
vocab.why: 来自古法语 tablete，意思是小板子。一块扁扁的小板，可以是平板电脑，也可以是药片。
vocab.tip: -et 是表示小的后缀，比如 booklet（小册子）。

vocab.zh: 在我的手机 / 平板上
ex: I watch videos on my cell phone.
vocab.why: I read books on my tablet. ## 我在平板上看书。
vocab.tip: 用设备做事，介词用 on。

vocab.zh: 在我的电脑 / 笔记本电脑上
ex: I do my homework on my laptop.
我在笔记本电脑上写作业。
vocab.why: I play games on my computer. ## 我在电脑上玩游戏。
vocab.tip: 用设备做事用 on。

ex: I read messages on my smartwatch.
我在智能手表上看消息。
vocab.why: I check the time on my smartwatch. ## 我用智能手表看时间。
vocab.tip: 用设备做事用 on。

ex: I watch movies on the internet.
vocab.why: I read news on the internet. ## 我在网上看新闻。
vocab.tip: 连接各个网络之间的网，就是互联网。

vocab.why: Her new album is great. ## 她的新专辑很棒。
vocab.tip: 拉丁语本义是白色的板子，用来写名单，后来指相册、唱片集。

vocab.why: This band is really popular. ## 这个乐队很受欢迎。
vocab.tip: 一群一起演奏的人。

vocab.why: sing（唱）→ song（歌），元音变化构成名词。
vocab.tip: 结尾 ng 读 /ŋ/，不要加 g 的音。

ex: This singer is really famous in China.
这个歌手在中国非常有名。
vocab.why: 和第 1 单元的 server、teacher 一样，-er 表示做这件事的人。
vocab.tip: singer 里的 g 不发音：/ˈsɪŋər/，不是 /ˈsɪŋɡər/。

ex: This singer is really famous in China.
这个歌手在中国非常有名。
vocab.why: It's a famous bridge. ## 这是一座著名的桥。
vocab.tip: 有名声的。

ex: 爵士乐在芝加哥很流行。
vocab.why: 大众的、人民喜欢的，就是受欢迎的。pop music（流行音乐）的 pop 就是 popular 的缩写。
vocab.tip: 重音在第一个音节：POP-u-lar。

vocab.why: I don't have a tablet. ## 我没有平板电脑。
vocab.tip: he / she 用 has。

vocab.why: I don't like it because it's slow. ## 我不喜欢，因为太慢。
vocab.tip: 程度：love > like > don't like。

vocab.why: We love our family. ## 我们爱我们的家人。
vocab.tip: 美国人说 love 很随意，喜欢一样东西也可以说 love。

vocab.why: I don't want expensive earphones. ## 我不想要贵的耳机。
vocab.tip: want to + 动词：I want to go。

vocab.zh: 给朋友 / 家人打电话
ex: I call my family every Sunday.
我每周日给家里打电话。
vocab.why: Do you call friends a lot? ## 你常给朋友打电话吗？
vocab.tip: call 后面直接跟人，不加 to。

vocab.why: I chat with my family every night. ## 我每晚和家人聊天。
vocab.tip: 和某人聊天：chat with someone。

ex: I listen to music on the bus.
vocab.why: Do you listen to music on your phone? ## 你用手机听音乐吗？
vocab.tip: listen 后面要加 to。

ex: I play games on my phone.
vocab.why: My son plays games every day. ## 我儿子每天玩游戏。
vocab.tip: 玩游戏、打球都用 play。

ex: I post photos of L.A. for my family.
我发洛杉矶的照片给家人看。
vocab.why: Do you post comments? ## 你发评论吗？
vocab.tip: 本义是贴告示，网上发东西也叫 post。

ex: I read emails on my laptop.
我在笔记本电脑上看邮件。
vocab.why: I read messages on my smartwatch. ## 我在智能手表上看消息。
vocab.tip: 现在时读 /riːd/，过去式拼写一样，读 /red/。

ex: I send a lot of text messages.
vocab.why: Do you and your friends send emails? ## 你和你朋友发邮件吗？
vocab.tip: 发短信也可以直接说 text：Text me!

vocab.why: Please leave a message. ## 请留言。
vocab.tip: 电话没人接时，留下声音消息。

vocab.zh: 用应用 / 社交媒体 / 科技产品
vocab.why: I use a lot of apps. ## 我用很多应用。
vocab.tip: 动词 use 读 /juːz/，名词读 /juːs/。

vocab.zh: 看电影 / 视频 / 电视
ex: I watch videos on my phone.
vocab.why: We watch TV after dinner. ## 我们晚饭后看电视。
vocab.tip: 看会动的画面用 watch；看书、看字用 read。

ex: I want a phone plan for three months.
我想办三个月的电话套餐。
vocab.why: plan 本义是计划，在电话公司指套餐。
vocab.tip: 短期在美国的人一般办 prepaid plan，不用查信用记录。

ex: I read product reviews before I buy.
买东西前我会看产品评价。
vocab.why: This product review is helpful. ## 这条产品评价很有用。
vocab.tip: review = 再看一遍，评论。

phrases.reply: Yes, I want a phone plan.
phrases.tip: 店员的固定开场白。不需要帮忙就说 I'm just looking, thanks.

phrases.en: Do you use a lot of data?
phrases.tip: 回答用 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
否定：don't + 动词原形。
说完自己的情况，用它把话题抛回给对方，对话就能聊下去。
别人说话时时不时插一句，表示你在听，美国人很看重这一点。

phrases.reply: Hmm. I don't want expensive earphones.
sim: I don't like it because it's slow.
phrases.tip: but 连接相反的意思，because 说明原因。
聊音乐、电影是和美国人破冰的好话题。
美国人说 love 很随意，喜欢一首歌、一杯咖啡都可以说 I love it!

grammar.title: 一般现在时：I / you / we
rows:
I love my phone.
We chat on apps.

I don't (do not) have a tablet.
You don't want a watch.

Do you use social media?
Do you and your friends send emails?

Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
Yes, we do. / No, we don't.
grammar.tip: 否定和疑问都要加助动词 do，后面的动词用原形。
grammar.say: Do you use social media? Yes, I do. I don't have a tablet.

grammar.title: a / an 和形容词的位置
rows: a phone, a laptop, a great app
an app, an email, an old laptop, an expensive plan

a new phone（不说 a phone new）
They're great earphones.
grammar.tip: 看后面那个词的第一个音：元音开头用 an，辅音开头用 a。形容词放在名词前面，而且没有复数：expensive earphones，不说 expensives。
grammar.say: It's an app. It's a great app. They're expensive earphones.

pron.title: 句子里的重读词
pron.explain: 英语句子不是每个词都一样重。名词、动词、形容词、否定词这些带意思的词要重读、拉长；a、the、to、my 这些小词读得又轻又快。下面大写的是重读的词，点开听节奏。
list: 否定词 don't 要重读

readings.title: Product reviews: FlowBeat earphones
readings.text: Five stars. Great earphones! I love these earphones. They're small and light, and the sound is great. I listen to music on the bus every day. They're not cheap, but they're good. Mia, Seattle. Two stars. Not for me. The sound is OK, but I don't like them because they're not comfortable. And the battery is bad. I want my money back! Dan, Denver.
readings.zh: 五星。很棒的耳机！我太喜欢这副耳机了，小巧轻便，音质很好。我每天在公交车上用它听音乐。不便宜，但是好用。——米娅，西雅图。两星。不适合我。音质还行，但我不喜欢，因为戴着不舒服，而且电池很差。我要退钱！——丹，丹佛。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ you listen to music on your phone?
grammarQuiz.why: 主语是 you，一般疑问句用 Do。
I 的否定用 don't + 动词原形。
app 以元音开头，用 an。
复数名词前不用 a/an，形容词也没有复数形式。

writingTask.title: 写一条产品评价
writingTask.task: 选一样你常用的电子产品（手机、耳机、平板等），写一条网上的产品评价：你喜欢它什么、不喜欢什么。
writingTask.focus: 用 but 和 because：It's great, but it's expensive. / I love it because it's fast.
checklist: 说了喜欢的地方
用 but 说了一个缺点
用 because 说明了原因
用了 I love / I like / I don't like
writingTask.model: Four stars. I love my new earphones because they're small and light. I listen to music on the bus every day, and the sound is great. They're good, but they're expensive. I don't like the case because it's big.

units.title: Mondays and fun days
goals: 谈论工作日和周末的活动
表示同意、表示我也一样
写一份自己的活动报告

dialogues.title: What Time Do You Get Up?
dialogues.zh: 艾玛和伟聊作息
lines: I am! I get up at six every day.
My company is in China. When it's morning here, it's evening there.
我的公司在中国。这边早上的时候，那边是晚上。
Oh, I see. What time do you go to bed?
I usually go to bed at midnight. I'm a night person.
我通常半夜十二点睡。我是夜猫子。
Do you work on the weekend?
No, I don't. I never work on Saturdays or Sundays.
不，我周六周日从不工作。
Me, neither. Saturday is my fun day!
我也不。周六是我玩的日子！

dialogues.title: Carlos's Week
dialogues.zh: 伟向艾玛打听卡洛斯的作息
lines: He's a chef. He works at a restaurant downtown.
他是厨师，在市中心一家餐厅工作。
No, he doesn't. He works Tuesday to Saturday.
不是。他周二到周六上班。
At three in the afternoon. He finishes at eleven at night.
下午三点，晚上十一点下班。
Wow, that's late. Does he have time for sports?
哇，好晚。他有时间运动吗？
Yes. He plays soccer on Monday mornings.
Really? Ask him. He always needs players.
真的吗？问问他吧，他们总是缺人。

vocab.why: See you on Monday! ## 周一见！
vocab.tip: 月亮日。

vocab.why: It's Tuesday today. ## 今天星期二。
vocab.tip: 以北欧神话的战神命名。

ex: The museum is free on Wednesday.
vocab.why: I go to the gym on Wednesdays. ## 我每周三去健身房。
vocab.tip: 以北欧主神奥丁（古英语 Woden）命名。

vocab.why: I'm busy on Thursday. ## 我周四很忙。
vocab.tip: 以雷神托尔命名。

ex: I go out on Friday nights.
vocab.why: Have a nice weekend! It's Friday! ## 周末愉快！今天周五！
vocab.tip: 以北欧神话的女神命名。

vocab.why: What do they do on Saturday? ## 他们周六做什么？
vocab.tip: 以罗马农神萨图恩（土星）命名。

vocab.why: We have brunch on Sundays. ## 我们每周日吃早午餐。
vocab.tip: 太阳日。

ex: I have class in the afternoon.
vocab.why: Good afternoon! ## 下午好！
vocab.tip: 中午之后。

ex: I take an English class in the evening.
vocab.why: Good evening. ## 晚上好。
vocab.tip: 下午结束到睡觉前这段时间。

ex: I drink coffee in the morning.
vocab.why: Good morning! ## 早上好！
vocab.tip: 从天亮到中午。

vocab.why: Good night! ## 晚安！
vocab.tip: gh 不发音。Good night 是睡前道别，见面不说。

ex: What do you do on the weekend?
vocab.why: I never work on the weekend. ## 我周末从不工作。
vocab.tip: 一周的末尾。

vocab.why: The café is quiet on weekdays. ## 工作日咖啡馆很安静。
vocab.tip: 周一到周五。

vocab.why: Many Americans check emails at night. ## 很多美国人晚上查邮件。
vocab.tip: night 前用 at，其他时段用 in the。

vocab.zh: 在早上 / 下午 / 傍晚
ex: I get up early in the morning.
vocab.why: I have free time in the evening. ## 我晚上有空。
vocab.tip: 一天中的时段用 in the。

vocab.w: on Monday / Thursday / the weekend / weekdays
vocab.zh: 在周一 / 周四 / 周末 / 工作日
vocab.why: I work on weekdays. ## 我工作日上班。
vocab.tip: 具体某一天用 on。
vocab.say: on Monday, Thursday, the weekend, weekdays

ex: I drink coffee in the morning.
vocab.why: Do you drink tea? ## 你喝茶吗？
vocab.tip: 过去式 drank。

vocab.zh: 吃早饭 / 午饭 / 晚饭
vocab.why: We eat dinner at six. ## 我们六点吃晚饭。
vocab.tip: breakfast 是打破一夜的禁食。三餐前不加 the。

ex: I get up at six every day.
What time do you get up?
She gets up late on Sundays.
vocab.why: 从躺着变成起来。注意 wake up 是醒来，get up 是下床起来。
vocab.tip: 他/她起床：He gets up，要加 s。

ex: Do you go out with friends?
vocab.why: They don't go out every evening. ## 他们不是每晚都出去。
vocab.tip: 指出去社交、娱乐。

vocab.zh: 去睡觉 / 上班 / 上课
ex: I go to bed at ten-thirty.
vocab.why: When does he go to classes? ## 他什么时候去上课？
vocab.tip: bed、work 前面不加 the。

ex: He plays soccer on Monday mornings.
vocab.why: My dad doesn't play soccer. ## 我爸爸不踢足球。
vocab.tip: 美国说 soccer，因为 football 在美国指橄榄球。

ex: Do you always run at lunch?
你总在午饭时间跑步吗？
vocab.why: I run in the park. ## 我在公园跑步。
vocab.tip: -ing 形式双写 n：running。

vocab.why: She studies at night. ## 她晚上学习。
vocab.tip: 和 student 同源。

vocab.why: I work from nine to five. ## 我朝九晚五。
vocab.tip: 读 /wɝːk/，和 walk /wɔːk/ 区分。

ex: It's eight o'clock. Time for class!
vocab.why: The store opens at eight o'clock. ## 商店八点开门。
vocab.tip: o'clock 只用在整点。

vocab.why: The bus comes at five fifteen. ## 公交车五点十五分来。
vocab.tip: 美国人最常直接读数字。

vocab.why: Let's meet at three-thirty. ## 三点半见。
vocab.tip: 半点直接读 thirty。

vocab.why: My flight is at ten forty-five. ## 我的航班十点四十五分。
vocab.tip: 直接读数字。

vocab.why: See you at a quarter after five. ## 五点一刻见。
vocab.tip: 一刻钟 = 一小时的四分之一。

vocab.why: The movie starts at a quarter to eleven. ## 电影十点四十五开始。
vocab.tip: 离十一点还差一刻。

vocab.why: Class starts at nine-oh-five. ## 九点零五分上课。
vocab.tip: 分钟是个位数时，0 读 oh。

vocab.why: The train leaves at six fifty. ## 火车六点五十分开。
vocab.tip: 直接读数字。

ex: It's twelve p.m. Time for lunch!
vocab.why: The store closes at twelve p.m. ## 商店中午十二点关门。
rel: 拉丁 post meridiem：中午之后
vocab.tip: p.m. 是下午和晚上。12 p.m. 是中午。

vocab.why: The party ends at 12:00 a.m. ## 派对半夜十二点结束。
rel: 拉丁 ante meridiem：中午之前
vocab.tip: 12 a.m. 是半夜。

vocab.why: He's late. It's five after nine. ## 他迟到了，都九点过五分了。
vocab.tip: 先说分钟，再说点钟。

vocab.why: Let's leave at ten to seven. ## 我们差十分七点出发吧。
vocab.tip: 离七点还差十分钟。

vocab.why: I meet my friends at noon. ## 我中午见朋友。
vocab.tip: 正午十二点。

vocab.why: I go to bed at midnight. ## 我半夜十二点睡觉。
vocab.tip: 夜的中间。

ex: I always drink coffee in the morning.
vocab.why: 古英语里是所有的路，后来变成任何时候、总是。
vocab.tip: 频率从高到低：always > usually > often > sometimes > hardly ever > never。

vocab.why: I hardly ever eat breakfast. ## 我几乎从不吃早饭。
vocab.tip: 比 never 稍微多一点点。

ex: I never work on the weekend.
vocab.why: 不在任何时候，就是从不。
vocab.tip: never 本身是否定，不要再加 don't：I never work，不说 I don't never work。

ex: I often go to the beach.
vocab.why: How often do you study? ## 你多久学一次？
vocab.tip: t 一般不发音：/ˈɔːfən/。

ex: I sometimes eat lunch at my desk.
我有时在办公桌吃午饭。
Sometimes I go out on Fridays.
We sometimes play soccer in the park.
vocab.why: 有些时候，就是有时。
vocab.tip: sometimes 可以放句首，其他频率副词一般不放句首。

ex: I usually get up at six.
She usually has coffee for breakfast.
Do you always run at lunch? — Usually.
你总在午饭时间跑步吗？——一般是。
vocab.why: 形容词 usual 加 -ly 变成副词。unusual（不寻常的）加了否定前缀 un-。
vocab.tip: 频率副词放在动词前、be 动词后：I usually get up… / I'm usually tired.

ex: After work, I go to the gym.
vocab.why: Turn off your phone after dinner. ## 晚饭后关掉手机。
vocab.tip: 反义词 before。

vocab.why: Do they have dinner before you? ## 他们比你先吃晚饭吗？
vocab.tip: 在前面。

vocab.why: She has fun, but not every day. ## 她过得开心，但不是每天都这样。
vocab.tip: 后面接单数名词：every day。

vocab.zh: 从上午八点到下午三点
ex: I work from 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
我从早八点工作到下午三点。
vocab.why: The museum is open from 10:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. ## 博物馆上午十点到下午五点开放。
vocab.tip: 说时间段：from … to …。

vocab.why: Don't be late! ## 别迟到！
vocab.tip: 反义词 early。

ex: 你早上的作息是怎样的？
Exercise is part of my routine.
运动是我日常的一部分。
vocab.why: 来自法语 route（路线），每天走同样的路线，就是例行公事、日常作息。
vocab.tip: 重音在后：rou-TINE。

vocab.why: -ed 结尾的形容词表示人的感受：tired 感到累；-ing 结尾表示让人有这种感觉：tiring 让人累的。
vocab.tip: I'm tired.（我累了）vs. My job is tiring.（我的工作很累人）

ex: I like the American way of life.
我喜欢美国的生活方式。
vocab.why: Work is part of my way of life. ## 工作是我生活方式的一部分。
vocab.tip: 一种生活的方式。

phrases.en: What time do you get up?
sim: What time do you go to bed?
phrases.tip: 回答用 at + 时间。

sim: 你知道现在几点吗？（问陌生人）
phrases.tip: 问陌生人时间说 Excuse me, do you have the time?，别说 Do you have time?（那是问对方有没有空）。
对肯定句表示我也一样：I love coffee. — Me, too.
对否定句表示我也不：I don't work on Saturdays. — Me, neither. 美国口语里 neither 读 /ˈniːðər/。
表示同意的几种说法，换着用更自然。

sim: Does she have time for sports?
phrases.tip: he/she 的疑问句用 does，后面的动词不加 s。

phrases.en: Do you always eat breakfast? — Usually.
phrases.tip: 用一个频率副词就能回答，简短自然。
周五道别的标准说法，回答 You too!

grammar.title: 一般现在时：he / she / they
rows:
He works Monday to Friday.
She has fun on the weekend.
They go out on Fridays.

She doesn't have time for sports.
They don't go out every evening.

work → works, go → goes
watch → watches, study → studies
have → has
grammar.tip: he / she / it 做主语时动词加 s；否定用 doesn't，后面动词恢复原形：She doesn't work（不说 doesn't works）。
grammar.say: He works Monday to Friday. She doesn't have time for sports.

grammar.title: 一般现在时的疑问句和频率副词
rows:
Do you go out with friends?
Does he go to classes every day?

What time do you get up?
Where does she work?
When does he start work?
I always / usually / often / sometimes / hardly ever / never run at lunch.

I usually get up at six.
She's always late.
grammar.tip: 频率副词放在实义动词前、be 动词后。
grammar.say: What time do you get up? I usually get up at six.

grammar.title: 说时间
rows:
5:15 a quarter after five
10:45 a quarter to eleven
3:30 three-thirty
grammar.tip: 美国人最常直接读数字：ten forty-five。a.m. 是上午，p.m. 是下午和晚上。
grammar.say: It's ten forty-five. It's a quarter to eleven. It's noon.

pron.title: 数音节
pron.explain: 英语单词按音节一拍一拍读，每个音节里有一个元音。中国学生常把辅音后面加个元音，把一个音节读成两个，比如 work 读成 work-e。点开听，跟着拍手数音节。
list: 一拍，结尾 k 不要加元音

readings.title: Work, rest, and play
readings.text: Most people in the U.S. work from Monday to Friday, from nine to five. But a lot of people work more. Many Americans check emails at night and on the weekend. This is not good for your body. Your body needs rest. Here are three ideas. First, turn off your phone after dinner. Second, go to bed at the same time every day. Third, do something fun on the weekend: play a sport, see friends, or take a walk in the park.
readings.zh: 美国大多数人周一到周五上班，朝九晚五。但很多人工作得更多，不少美国人晚上和周末也查邮件。这对身体不好，身体需要休息。这里有三个建议：第一，晚饭后关掉手机；第二，每天同一时间睡觉；第三，周末做点有趣的事：运动、见朋友，或者去公园散散步。

grammarQuiz.why: she 做主语，动词加 s。
he 的一般疑问句用 Does。
don't 后面用动词原形。

grammarQuiz.q: 我周末从不工作。I ___ work on the weekend.
grammarQuiz.why: 从不 = never。

writingTask.title: 写一份自己的活动报告
writingTask.task: 写一份简短报告，介绍你工作日和周末的作息：几点起床、几点上班、晚上做什么、周末做什么、频率如何。
writingTask.focus: 小标题和编号列表：用 Weekdays / The weekend 这样的小标题，用 1. 2. 3. 列出活动。
checklist: 有小标题
用编号列出了活动
至少用了两个频率副词（always / usually / sometimes / never）
说时间用了 at
writingTask.model:
Weekdays
1. I get up at six.
2. I have calls with my company in China at seven.
3. I usually take an English class in the evening.
The weekend
1. I always sleep late on Saturday.
2. I sometimes play soccer with Carlos.
3. I never work on Sunday.

units.title: Zoom in, zoom out
units.zh: 城市地点 · 问路指路

dialogues.title: Is There a Bookstore Near Here?
dialogues.zh: 伟在帕萨迪纳问路
lines: Excuse me. Is there a bookstore near here?
打扰一下，这附近有书店吗？
Yes, there's one on Colorado Boulevard.
有，科罗拉多大道上就有一家。
Go straight for two blocks. Then turn left on Colorado.
直走两个街区，然后在科罗拉多大道左转。
It's on the right, next to a café.
它在右手边，挨着一家咖啡馆。
So, go straight two blocks, turn left, and it's on the right?
所以是直走两个街区、左转，然后在右边？
No, it's about a five-minute walk.

dialogues.title: My New Neighborhood
dialogues.zh: 艾玛和伟聊各自住的街区
lines: I love it. There's a great café on my street, and there are some good restaurants.
我很喜欢。我那条街上有家很棒的咖啡馆，还有几家不错的餐厅。
Yes, there's a big supermarket near my house. But there's no park.
有，我家附近有个大超市。不过没有公园。
There are a lot of parks near my apartment. And there's a beach!
我公寓附近有很多公园，还有海滩！
Yes, I live in Santa Monica. Come and visit!
是啊，我住在圣莫尼卡。来玩吧！

ex: Is there a bookstore near here?
I buy English books at the bookstore.
The bookstore has a café, too.
这家书店还有个咖啡馆。
vocab.why: store 在美国就是商店，前面加卖的东西：bookstore、drugstore（药店）。
vocab.tip: 英国常说 shop，美国更常说 store。

ex: There's a great café on my street.
我那条街上有家很棒的咖啡馆。
vocab.why: 法语 café 本来就是咖啡的意思，后来指喝咖啡的店。
vocab.tip: 重音在后：ca-FÉ。美国人也常说 coffee shop。

ex: I'm a student at Pasadena City College.
我是帕萨迪纳城市学院的学生。
What's the name of your college?
vocab.why: 拉丁语本义是被选派到一起的一群人，后来指学者团体、学院。colleague（同事）也来自同一个词根。
vocab.tip: 美国口语里 go to college 泛指上大学。

vocab.why: My sister works at a hospital. ## 我姐姐在医院工作。
vocab.tip: 和 hotel、host 同源，原意是接待客人的地方。

vocab.why: Let's meet at the hotel. ## 我们在酒店见吧。
vocab.tip: 和 hospital、host 同源。

ex: The mall has a movie theater.
I buy clothes at the mall.
vocab.why: 来自伦敦一条叫 The Mall 的林荫步道，后来指人们散步购物的地方。
vocab.tip: 去商场说 go to the mall，在商场 at the mall。

ex: Let's go to the movie theater.
vocab.why: The mall has a movie theater. ## 商场里有电影院。
vocab.tip: 美国说 movie theater，英国说 cinema。

ex: There are some interesting museums near the park.
公园附近有几个有意思的博物馆。
The museum is free on Thursdays.
parts: 缪斯（希腊神话中掌管艺术的女神）
vocab.why: 来自希腊语 Mouseion，缪斯女神的殿堂。music（音乐）也来自缪斯。
vocab.tip: 重音在中间：mu-SE-um。

ex: There's a zoo in the park.
Let's take a walk in the park.
vocab.why: 原指围起来的一块地，后来指公园；停车场 parking lot 是围起来停车的地方。
vocab.tip: 美式 r 要卷舌：/pɑːrk/。

vocab.why: He works at a restaurant downtown. ## 他在市中心一家餐厅工作。
vocab.tip: 原意是让人恢复体力的地方。

vocab.why: My kids go to school here. ## 我的孩子在这里上学。
vocab.tip: 古希腊语本义是闲暇，后来指利用闲暇讨论学问的地方。

ex: Is there a store near here?
vocab.why: The store opens at nine. ## 商店九点开门。
vocab.tip: 本义是储存东西的地方，在美国就是商店。

ex: There's a big supermarket near my house.
I go to the supermarket on Sundays.
The supermarket is open twenty-four hours.
这家超市二十四小时营业。
vocab.why: 超大的市场就是超市。super- 也出现在 superstar（超级明星）。
vocab.tip: 美国人口语里也常说 grocery store。

ex: There's a zoo in the park.
vocab.why: Let's take the kids to the zoo. ## 我们带孩子去动物园吧。
vocab.tip: zoo- 是动物的意思。

ex: There's a beach near my apartment.
Let's go to the beach on Saturday.
The beach is beautiful at sunset.
vocab.why: 加州海岸线很长，beach 是洛杉矶人最常说的地方之一。
vocab.tip: 一定读长音 /iː/，读短了会变成一个骂人的词。

ex: There's a desert near Las Vegas.
拉斯维加斯附近有沙漠。
vocab.why: The desert is very hot. ## 沙漠很热。
vocab.tip: 被人离开、遗弃的地方。

ex: There are a lot of flowers.
vocab.why: I love these flowers. ## 我喜欢这些花。
vocab.tip: 和 flour（面粉）读音一样。

ex: It is a nice, big forest.
这是一片漂亮的大森林。
vocab.why: There are very old trees in the forest. ## 森林里有很古老的树。
vocab.tip: 拉丁语本义是城外的林地。

ex: There's a lot of grass in the park.
vocab.why: Don't walk on the grass. ## 请勿践踏草坪。
vocab.tip: 不可数：a lot of grass。

ex: The park is in the hills.
vocab.why: Let's walk up the hill. ## 我们走上山坡吧。
vocab.tip: 比 mountain 小。

ex: Walk to the top of the island.
vocab.why: Hawaii is a group of islands. ## 夏威夷是一群岛屿。
vocab.tip: s 不发音，是后来受 isle 影响加上的。

ex: There's a lake in the park.
vocab.why: We swim in the lake in summer. ## 我们夏天在湖里游泳。
vocab.tip: 湖名前常加 Lake：Lake Tahoe。

ex: There are mountains near the city.
We go to the mountains in winter.
vocab.why: Mount 放在山名前：Mount Everest（珠穆朗玛峰）。
vocab.tip: 美国人读 /ˈmaʊntən/ 时，中间的 t 常常几乎听不到。

ex: The Pacific Ocean is near L.A.
太平洋就在洛杉矶旁边。
There's a lot of water in the ocean.
I want to swim in the ocean.
parts: 希腊神话 Okeanos：环绕世界的大河
vocab.why: 古希腊人认为有一条大河环绕着整个世界，叫 Okeanos。
vocab.tip: c 读 /ʃ/：/ˈoʊʃən/。美国人说去海边常用 ocean，比 sea 常用。

vocab.why: I have plants in my room. ## 我房间里有植物。
vocab.tip: 动词是种植，名词是植物。

ex: There's a river in my city.
vocab.why: There are two rivers. ## 有两条河。
vocab.tip: 和第 9 单元的 arrive（到岸）同源。

vocab.why: There's a lot of snow in the mountains. ## 山里有很多雪。
vocab.tip: 不可数。

ex: There are a lot of trees.
vocab.why: This tree is very old. ## 这棵树很老了。
vocab.tip: 可数：a tree, two trees。

ex: Let's go shopping at the mall.
vocab.why: My friends aren't going to go shopping. ## 我朋友们不打算去购物。
vocab.tip: go + 动词-ing 表示去做某种活动：go swimming。

ex: 我们去市中心吃晚饭吧。
vocab.why: We have dinner at seven. ## 我们七点吃晚饭。
vocab.tip: 三餐前不加 the。

ex: I want to learn to surf.
vocab.why: They're learning a lot at school. ## 他们在学校学到很多。
vocab.tip: learn 侧重学会，study 侧重学习的过程。

ex: I see friends on the weekend.
vocab.why: Let's see friends this Saturday. ## 这周六我们去见朋友吧。
vocab.tip: see 也有见面的意思。

ex: Is there a park in your neighborhood?
parts: 邻居（near 近 + bour 住的人）
vocab.why: 住得近的人组成的地方。-hood 还出现在 childhood（童年）、brotherhood（兄弟情谊）。
vocab.tip: 美式拼写 neighborhood，英式 neighbourhood。gh 不发音。

phrases.en: Excuse me. Is there a bookstore near here?
phrases.zh: 打扰一下，这附近有书店吗？
phrases.reply: Yes, there's one on Colorado Boulevard.
phrases.tip: 问路先说 Excuse me。

sim: How do I get to the beach?
phrases.tip: get to + 地点 = 到达某地。
美国人指路几乎都用 block 说距离。
在某条街转弯用 on + 街名，在路口用 at。

phrases.en: It's on the right, next to a café.
phrases.zh: 在右手边，挨着一家咖啡馆。
phrases.tip: 左右都用 on：on the left / on the right。

phrases.en: So, go straight and turn left?
sim: Sorry, can you say that again?
phrases.tip: 把听到的路线复述一遍，确认没听错，这是很实用的沟通技巧。

phrases.en: Is it far? — No, it's a five-minute walk.
phrases.tip: five-minute 中间有连字符，minute 不加 s。
表示惊讶，语气友好。

grammar.title: There is / There are + a lot of, some, no
rows:
There's a café near here.
There's a zoo in the park.

There are some good restaurants.
There are a lot of parks.

There's no park.
There are no oceans near here.

Is there a supermarket? — Yes, there is.
Are there any museums? — No, there aren't.
grammar.tip: some = 一些（少量），a lot of = 很多，no = 一个也没有。There's = There is。
grammar.say: There's a great café on my street, and there are some good restaurants. But there's no park.

grammar.title: 可数名词和不可数名词
rows: a tree, two trees, a lot of flowers

water, grass, snow
不加 a，没有复数

some / a lot of / no
There's a lot of water. There are a lot of trees.
grammar.tip: 不可数名词用 There's（单数）：There's some grass，不说 There are some grasses。
grammar.say: There are a lot of trees. There's a lot of water in the ocean.

pron.title: /ɪr/ 和 /er/
pron.explain: /ɪr/ 嘴巴小一点，像 ear（耳朵）；/er/ 嘴巴张大一点，像 air（空气）。here 和 there、near 和 where 的区别就在这里。

readings.title: Fact sheet: Griffith Park, Los Angeles
readings.text: Griffith Park is a big park in Los Angeles. It's in the hills near Hollywood. There are a lot of trails for hiking, and there are great views of the city. There's a famous observatory on a hill. At night, people look at the stars there. There's also a zoo in the park. There's no beach, but there are a lot of trees, birds, and some small animals. It's a great place for a walk on the weekend.
readings.zh: 格里菲斯公园是洛杉矶的一个大公园，在好莱坞附近的山丘上。公园里有很多徒步小道，能看到很棒的城市风景。山上有一座著名的天文台，晚上人们在那儿看星星。公园里还有一个动物园。这里没有海滩，但有很多树、鸟和一些小动物。周末来散步再好不过。

grammarQuiz.why: 单数用 There's。
复数名词前可以用 some。
water 不可数，用 a lot of。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ there a park near your house?
grammarQuiz.why: a park 是单数，问句用 Is there。

writingTask.title: 写一份地点介绍
writingTask.task: 介绍你喜欢的一个自然景点或公园：在哪里、那里有什么、可以做什么。
writingTask.focus: 形容词顺序：表示看法的形容词在前，表示大小的在后，比如 a nice, big forest / a beautiful, small lake。
checklist: 说了地点在哪里
用了 There's / There are
用了 a lot of / some / no
至少用了两个形容词描述这个地方
writingTask.model: Griffith Park is a nice, big park in Los Angeles. It's in the hills near Hollywood. There are a lot of trails, and there are great views of the city. There's a famous observatory, and there's a zoo, too. There's no beach, but there are a lot of trees and birds. It's a great place for a walk.

units.title: Now is good
units.zh: 现在进行时 · 打电话
goals: 问答出行和交通的情况
写一篇关于近况的博客

dialogues.title: Good News
dialogues.zh: 艾玛给伟打电话分享好消息
lines: Good, thanks. What are you doing?
I'm cooking dinner. I'm making noodles.
Yum! Is this a bad time?
好香！我现在打扰你了吗？
I have news. I have a new job!
我有消息要告诉你。我找到新工作了！
Thanks! I'm teaching at a new college now.
谢谢！我现在在一所新学院教书。

dialogues.title: Running Late
dialogues.zh: 伟在公交车上，约会要迟到了
lines: Hi, Wei. Where are you? We're waiting for you at the café.
嗨，伟，你在哪儿？我们在咖啡馆等你呢。
Sorry! I'm running late. I'm on the bus.
抱歉！我要迟到了，我在公交车上。
Oh, no! Is the bus moving?
Yes, but it's very slow. There's a lot of traffic.
OK. Emma is ordering a coffee for you.
好吧。艾玛在帮你点咖啡。
Thanks! I'm getting off at the next stop.

ex: I brush my teeth every morning.
vocab.why: She's brushing her hair. ## 她在梳头。
vocab.tip: tooth 的复数是 teeth。

vocab.zh: 打扫厨房 / 我的房间
vocab.why: Clean your room! ## 收拾你的房间！
vocab.tip: 形容词和动词同形。

vocab.zh: 做早饭 / 午饭 / 晚饭
vocab.why: Who cooks dinner in your family? ## 你家谁做晚饭？
vocab.tip: 和第 3 单元的 kitchen 同源。

vocab.why: I cook, and you do the dishes. ## 我做饭，你洗碗。
vocab.tip: homework 不可数，不加 s。

ex: I'm helping my daughter with her homework.
vocab.why: Can you help me? ## 你能帮我吗？
vocab.tip: 帮某人做某事：help someone with something。

vocab.why: I take a bath on Sundays. ## 我周日泡澡。
vocab.tip: bath 是在浴缸里泡，shower 是淋浴。

vocab.why: I wash my hair every day. ## 我每天洗头。
vocab.tip: hair 指全部头发时不可数。

vocab.why: We wash the dog on Saturdays. ## 我们每周六给狗洗澡。
vocab.tip: 给宠物洗澡也用 wash。

vocab.w: be at the bus stop / train station
vocab.why: I'm at the train station. ## 我在火车站。
vocab.tip: 在一个具体地点用 at。
vocab.say: be at the bus stop, train station

vocab.w: be on the bus / train / subway
vocab.zh: 在公交车 / 火车 / 地铁上
vocab.why: She's on the subway. ## 她在地铁上。
vocab.tip: 大型公共交通工具用 on。
vocab.say: be on the bus, train, subway

vocab.why: Why is he carrying a plant? ## 他为什么拿着一盆植物？
vocab.tip: 拿着走、带着东西用 carry。

vocab.why: Can you drive? ## 你会开车吗？
vocab.tip: 开车的人是 driver。

vocab.w: go to the mall / a store / your parents' house
vocab.zh: 去商场 / 商店 / 你父母家
vocab.why: Are you going to your parents' house? ## 你要去你父母家吗？
vocab.tip: parents' 是复数名词的所有格。
vocab.say: go to the mall, a store, your parents' house

vocab.zh: 骑你的 / 我的自行车
ex: I ride my bike to school.
vocab.why: Ride your bike to the park! ## 骑车去公园吧！
vocab.tip: bike 是 bicycle 的缩写：bi-（二）+ cycle（轮）。

vocab.zh: 坐公交 / 火车 / 地铁
ex: I take the bus to work.
vocab.why: Take the subway. It's fast. ## 坐地铁吧，很快。
vocab.tip: 乘坐交通工具用 take。

ex: Are they waiting at the bus stop?
vocab.why: Who are they waiting for? ## 他们在等谁？
vocab.tip: 等某人：wait for someone。

vocab.why: Let's walk in the park. ## 我们在公园走走吧。
vocab.tip: l 不发音：/wɔːk/。

vocab.why: Ha ha, I know! ## 哈哈，我知道！
vocab.tip: 美国人发消息时常写 haha 或 lol（laughing out loud）。

ex: The kids are making a lot of noise!
vocab.why: How old are your kids? ## 你的孩子多大了？
vocab.tip: 本义是小山羊，口语里指孩子。

vocab.why: Millions of people live in L.A. ## 数百万人住在洛杉矶。
vocab.tip: 一千个一千 = 一百万。

ex: The kids are making a lot of noise!
vocab.why: There's a lot of noise outside. ## 外面很吵。
vocab.tip: 形容词是 noisy（第 11 单元）。

vocab.why: The bus is running late. ## 公交车晚点了。
vocab.tip: run 在这里不是跑，而是事情进行的状态。

phrases.tip: 打电话自报姓名用 It's … 或 This is …，不说 I'm Emma。

phrases.en: How's it going? — Not bad, thanks.
phrases.zh: 最近怎么样？——还不错，谢谢。
phrases.tip: 美国人打招呼最常用的一句，回答简短就好，再反问一句。

sim: What are you doing these days?
phrases.tip: these days 是最近这段时间。
打电话时先问一句，显得很有礼貌。
对别人的消息要有反应：好消息说 Oh, wow!，坏消息说 Oh, no!，中性的说 Oh.。
一定要加 s：Congratulations!

sim: I'll be there in ten minutes.
phrases.tip: 迟到前主动说一声，比到了再道歉更好。

sim: I'm getting off at the next stop.
phrases.tip: 公交、火车、地铁、飞机用 on；小汽车、出租车用 in：in a taxi。

grammar.title: 现在进行时：陈述句
rows:
I'm cooking breakfast right now.
They're learning a lot this year.

He isn't drinking his milk.
You're not eating your breakfast.

cook → cooking
make → making（去 e）
run → running（双写）
grammar.tip: be + 动词-ing，表示现在正在做，或这段时间在做（these days）。
grammar.say: I'm cooking breakfast right now. He isn't drinking his milk.

grammar.title: 现在进行时：疑问句
rows:
Are you going to work?
Is she carrying a plant?

Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, she is. / No, she isn't.

What are you doing?
Who are they waiting for?
Why is he carrying a plant?
grammar.tip: 把 am / is / are 提到主语前面。
grammar.say: What are you doing? Are you going to work? Yes, I am.

pron.title: -ing 结尾的 /ŋ/
pron.explain: -ing 结尾的 ng 读 /ŋ/：舌根抵住软腭，气从鼻子出来，像中文的 ang、eng 的尾音。不要读成 /n/，也不要在后面加一个 g 的音。

readings.title: Wei's blog: My life in L.A. these days
readings.text: Hi, everyone! It's Saturday morning, and I'm sitting in a café in Pasadena. I'm drinking coffee and writing this blog. Life is busy these days. I'm working a lot, and I'm taking an English class in the evenings. I'm also learning to cook American food! My roommate Jake is teaching me. Right now, people are walking their dogs outside, and the sun is shining. It's a beautiful day, and I'm happy here.
readings.zh: 大家好！现在是周六早上，我正坐在帕萨迪纳的一家咖啡馆里，一边喝咖啡一边写这篇博客。最近生活很忙，我工作很多，晚上还在上英语课。我还在学做美国菜！我的室友杰克在教我。这会儿外面有人在遛狗，阳光正好。今天天气真好，我在这儿很开心。

grammarQuiz.why: I 用 am，现在进行时 am + -ing。
you 用 are，问句把 are 提前。
is 后面用 -ing 形式。
they 用 are。

writingTask.title: 写一篇博客：你现在的生活
writingTask.task: 写一篇博客，说说你此刻在做什么，以及最近这段时间在忙什么。
writingTask.focus: 用 and / also / too 补充信息：I'm working a lot, and I'm taking a class. I'm also learning to cook. My roommate is busy, too.
checklist: 用了现在进行时 am / is / are + -ing
说了此刻在做的事
说了最近在忙的事
用了 and、also 或 too
writingTask.model: Hi, everyone! It's Saturday morning, and I'm sitting in a café. I'm drinking coffee and writing this blog. These days, I'm working a lot, and I'm taking an English class. I'm also learning to cook American food. My roommate Jake is teaching me. He's very busy, too!

units.title: You're good!
goals: 谈论自己的技能和能力
说说工作或学习中能做和不能做的事
说明自己为什么适合一份工作
写一条发表看法的网络评论

dialogues.title: A Job Interview
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯在餐厅面试新服务员安娜
lines: So, Ana, why do you want this job?
那么安娜，你为什么想要这份工作？
I love food, and I like people.
我喜欢美食，也喜欢和人打交道。
很好。你会说西班牙语吗？
Yes, I can. I speak two languages. I mean, Spanish and English.
会。我会说两种语言，就是西班牙语和英语。
Good. A lot of our customers speak Spanish. Can you work on weekends?
很好，我们很多客人说西班牙语。你周末能上班吗？
Yes, I can. But I can't work on Monday mornings. I have classes.
可以。不过周一上午不行，我有课。
That's OK. Can you carry three plates?
没关系。你能一次端三个盘子吗？
Ha, yes, I can! And I'm a fast learner.
哈，能！而且我学东西很快。
I think you're the right person for this job.
我觉得你就是这份工作的合适人选。

dialogues.title: Can You Surf?
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯想教伟冲浪
lines: Yes, I can, but not very well. Why?
会，但游得不太好。怎么了？
I can teach you. It's easy.
I don't think so. I think it's difficult.
我可不这么觉得，我觉得很难。
What do you think, Emma? Can Wei learn?
艾玛，你觉得呢？伟能学会吗？
I think so. He's a fast learner.
我觉得能，他学东西很快。
OK, OK. Good idea. Let's try!
好吧好吧，好主意，试试看！

ex: The name of my company is Pacific Trade.
我的公司叫太平洋贸易。
She works for a big company.
vocab.why: 本义是一起吃面包的人，也就是伙伴。一群伙伴一起做生意，就成了公司。
vocab.tip: 公司名常缩写为 Co.，比如 Pacific Trade Co.。

ex: I have lunch with my coworkers.
vocab.why: 一起工作的人。co- 还出现在 co-pilot（副驾驶）、cooperate（合作）。
vocab.tip: 美国日常口语里 coworker 比 colleague 更常用。

ex: We have a meeting at ten.
vocab.why: Where can you have a meeting? ## 在哪里可以开会？
vocab.tip: meet（见面）+ -ing = 会议。

ex: Your dog can come to the office.
The office is on the third floor.
vocab.why: 来自拉丁语 officium（职责、工作），和 officer（官员）、official（官方的）同源。
vocab.tip: 美式常读 /ˈɑːfɪs/，也有人读 /ˈɔːfɪs/。

ex: You can take a break any time.
I take a break at three.
vocab.why: break 本义是打断，工作中打断一下就是休息。breakfast（第 5 单元）里也有 break。
vocab.tip: Let's take a five-minute break. = 休息五分钟。

vocab.why: What do you think? ## 你觉得呢？
vocab.tip: 过去式 thought。

ex: How can companies make their workers happy?
vocab.why: The workers are on a break. ## 工人们在休息。
vocab.tip: 工作的人。

ex: You can work hard and have fun.
你可以努力工作，也玩得开心。
vocab.why: She works hard every day. ## 她每天都努力工作。
vocab.tip: hard 在这里是副词，不加 -ly。

vocab.why: 加 -r 变成 dancer（舞者）。
vocab.tip: 美式读 /dæns/，英式读 /dɑːns/。

ex: Can you draw a map for me?
vocab.why: 本义是拉，用笔拉出线条就是画。drawer（抽屉）是拉出来的东西。
vocab.tip: 用铅笔、钢笔画用 draw；用颜料画用 paint。

ex: My phone is broken. Can you fix it?
vocab.why: 本义是固定，把松了、坏了的东西固定好，就是修理。
vocab.tip: 美国口语里修东西几乎都说 fix。

vocab.why: We're painting the kitchen. ## 我们在粉刷厨房。
vocab.tip: 用颜料画用 paint，用笔画线条用 draw。

vocab.why: He plays the guitar in a band. ## 他在乐队里弹吉他。
vocab.tip: 演奏乐器时乐器前加 the。

vocab.why: Can you read music? ## 你会看乐谱吗？
vocab.tip: 读懂乐谱。

vocab.why: 第 4 单元学过 song（歌）、singer（歌手），都来自 sing。
vocab.tip: 过去式 sang，第 12 单元会学过去时。

vocab.why: My son skateboards in the park. ## 我儿子在公园玩滑板。
vocab.tip: 带轮子的滑行板。

vocab.why: Let's snowboard in the mountains. ## 我们去山里滑雪吧。
vocab.tip: 在雪上滑的板。

ex: Can I speak to Emma, please?
vocab.why: 名词是 speech（演讲），说话的人是 speaker（也指音箱）。
vocab.tip: 说某种语言用 speak：speak English，不说 say English。

ex: I surf the internet at night.
vocab.why: 本义是拍岸的海浪。surf the internet（在网上冲浪）就是上网浏览。
vocab.tip: 加州是美国冲浪文化的中心。

ex: I can swim, but not very well.
我会游泳，但游得不太好。
vocab.why: 家族词：swimmer（游泳的人）、swimming pool（游泳池）。注意双写 m：swimming。
vocab.tip: 去游泳：go swimming。

ex: 我所有的朋友都会游泳。
vocab.why: We all love music. ## 我们都喜欢音乐。
vocab.tip: 三个以上用 all，两个用 both。

ex: 这不是一间普通的办公室。
vocab.why: He's an ordinary guy. ## 他是个普通人。
vocab.tip: 按常规顺序的，就是普通的。

vocab.why: Can I pay by card? ## 可以刷卡吗？
vocab.tip: 过去式 paid。

ex: Robots can do a lot of things.
vocab.why: Can a robot cook? ## 机器人会做饭吗？
vocab.tip: 来自捷克作家的剧本，原意是强制劳动。

vocab.why: The weather is terrible. ## 天气糟透了。
vocab.tip: 本义是可怕的，现在常指很差。

phrases.en: Can you swim? — Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
phrases.zh: 你会游泳吗？——会。/ 不会。
phrases.tip: 简短回答 can 要读完整、重读：Yes, I CAN。

sim: I can swim, but not very well.
phrases.tip: well 放在句末说做得好不好。

phrases.reply: I think it's a great idea.
phrases.tip: 征求别人意见时用，美国人讨论时很爱问这句。

phrases.en: I think so. / I don't think so.
phrases.zh: 我觉得是。/ 我觉得不是。
phrases.tip: 英语习惯把否定放在 think 上：I don't think it's easy.，不说 I think it's not easy.

phrases.en: I speak two languages. I mean, Chinese and English.
phrases.zh: 我会说两种语言，就是中文和英语。
phrases.tip: 用 I mean 补充解释，让对方更明白你的意思。
面试时推销自己的好用句子。
Let's + 动词原形 = 我们一起……吧。
回应别人的建议时用。

grammar.title: can / can't 表示能力
rows:
I can swim.
She can draw.
We can surf well.

I can't play the guitar.
He can't sing well.

Can you fix things?
Can they speak two languages?
Yes, I can. / No, I can't.
grammar.tip: can 后面用动词原形，而且 can 没有人称变化：He can swim，不说 He cans swims。
grammar.say: I can swim. She can draw. I can't play the guitar.

grammar.title: can / can't 表示可以、允许
rows:
You can take a break any time.
Your dog can come to work with you.

Where can you have a meeting?
How can companies make their workers happy?
grammar.tip: can 既可以表示会做，也可以表示允许做。
grammar.say: You can take a break any time. You can't park here.

pron.title: can 和 can't 的读音
pron.explain: 肯定句里 can 读得很轻、很短：/kən/，几乎只剩一个 k 音；can't 要重读、拉长：/kænt/，结尾的 t 美国人常常不爆破。所以听的时候，主要靠元音的轻重来分辨，不能只等那个 t。

readings.title: Comments: Dogs at work
readings.text: At our company, you can bring your dog to work. What do you think? Lily: I think it's a great idea. Dogs make people happy. You can take a break and play with them. Tom: I don't think so. Some people can't work with dogs in the office. And some people are afraid of dogs. Rosa: I think Lily is right. But Tom is right, too. Maybe the company can have a dog room.
readings.zh: 在我们公司，你可以带狗来上班。你怎么看？莉莉：我觉得是个好主意。狗让人开心，你可以休息一下，跟它们玩。汤姆：我不这么认为。有些人办公室里有狗就没法工作，还有些人怕狗。罗莎：我觉得莉莉说得对，但汤姆说得也对。也许公司可以设一个狗狗房间。

grammarQuiz.why: can 没有人称变化，后面直接跟动词原形。
can 的疑问句直接把 can 提前。
can't 后面用动词原形。

grammarQuiz.q: 下午三点你可以休息。You ___ take a break at 3:00.
grammarQuiz.why: can 表示允许、可以。

writingTask.title: 写一条网络评论
writingTask.task: 网上有人问：公司应该允许员工带狗上班吗？写一条评论，说出你的看法和理由。
writingTask.focus: 引用别人的话：用引号和 says，比如 Lily says, "Dogs make people happy."
checklist: 清楚地说出了自己的看法
用了 I think / I don't think
用了 can / can't
引用了别人的一句话
writingTask.model: I think it's a good idea, but not for every office. Lily says, "Dogs make people happy." I think Lily is right. You can take a break and play with them. But some people can't work with dogs in the office. Maybe the company can have a dog room.

units.title: Places to go
units.zh: 旅行计划 · 机场购物
goals: 在商店询问信息和价格

dialogues.title: A Trip to San Francisco
dialogues.zh: 伟和艾玛商量去旧金山
lines: I want to go to San Francisco next month.
Great idea! How do you want to travel?
I like to fly, but I need to save money.
我喜欢坐飞机，但我得省点钱。
You can take the train. It's slow, but it's beautiful.
你可以坐火车，慢是慢，但风景很美。
Hmm. I have to be back on Monday.
Then fly. The flight is about an hour and a half.
那就坐飞机吧，大约一个半小时。
OK. Where do I need to stay?
Stay downtown. And you have to see the Golden Gate Bridge!
住市中心。你一定要去看金门大桥！
I want to see it at sunset.
Then you need to check the weather. It's often foggy there.
那你得查查天气，那里经常有雾。

dialogues.title: At the Airport Store
dialogues.zh: 伟在机场商店买东西
lines: Excuse me. Where are the travel guides?
打扰一下，旅游指南在哪儿？
They're over there, next to the magazines.
Thanks. How much is this one?
Sorry, can you say that again?
OK, I'll take two. Oh, and where's the men's restroom?
好，我要两张。对了，男洗手间在哪儿？
It's on the left, next to Gate 12.
在左边，12 号登机口旁边。

vocab.why: We're on a boat. ## 我们在船上。
vocab.tip: 小船叫 boat，大船叫 ship。

vocab.why: I like the country. ## 我喜欢乡村。
vocab.tip: 本义是对面的土地。the country 指乡下。

vocab.why: There are cows on the farm. ## 农场上有牛。
vocab.tip: 农民叫 farmer。

vocab.why: I sleep on the plane. ## 我在飞机上睡觉。
vocab.tip: airplane 的缩写。

ex: 我们在这个很酷的牧场。
vocab.why: There are horses on the ranch. ## 牧场上有马。
vocab.tip: 美国西部养牛养马的大农场，来自西班牙语。

ex: Two tickets to San Francisco, please.
parts: 古法语 estiquet：贴着的标签
vocab.why: 本义是贴在东西上的小标签。etiquette（礼仪）也来自这个法语词。
vocab.tip: 在美国，罚单也叫 ticket：a parking ticket（停车罚单）。

ex: There's a free tour of the museum.
vocab.why: 转一圈看看就是游览。tourist（游客）、tourism（旅游业）都来自它。
vocab.tip: 美式读 /tʊr/。

vocab.why: Let's go into town. ## 我们进城吧。
vocab.tip: 比 city 小。

ex: Where do you go on vacation?
I have two weeks of vacation.
vocab.why: 把时间空出来，就是放假。vacant（空着的）、vacuum（真空）也来自这个词根。
vocab.tip: 美国说 vacation，英国说 holiday。

ex: Can you meet me at the airport?
洛杉矶国际机场是个大机场。
vocab.why: 天上的港口就是机场。第 1 单元的 passport（护照）= pass（通过）+ port（港口）。
vocab.tip: 洛杉矶国际机场简称 LAX。

vocab.why: Hawaii is a popular destination. ## 夏威夷是热门目的地。
vocab.tip: 被指定要去的地方。

ex: The flight is about an hour and a half.
My mom likes to sleep on a flight.
我妈喜欢在飞机上睡觉。
vocab.why: fly 的名词形式。gh 不发音。
vocab.tip: 在飞机上：on a flight。

vocab.why: Check in online. ## 在网上办理值机。
vocab.tip: 在网络线路上。

ex: I want to take a trip to San Francisco.
vocab.why: 去某个地方再回来的一趟出行。
vocab.tip: 去旅行：take a trip；别人出发前说 Have a nice trip!

ex: What time does the flight arrive?
She arrives in San Francisco on Monday.
vocab.why: 本义是到岸，船靠岸就是到达。
vocab.tip: 到达大地方用 arrive in（in L.A.），到达小地方用 arrive at（at the airport）。

vocab.why: I buy books online. ## 我在网上买书。
vocab.tip: 过去式 bought。

ex: You need to check in two hours before the flight.
你需要在起飞前两小时办理登机。
I'm checking in at the hotel.
vocab.why: 核对好信息、登记进去。反义是 check out（退房；结账）。
vocab.tip: 名词形式中间有连字符：check-in。

vocab.why: We fly to New York on Friday. ## 我们周五飞纽约。
vocab.tip: 名词形式是 flight。

ex: We want to leave on Friday.
What time do you leave work?
vocab.why: 离开某地：leave + 地点；去某地：leave for + 地点。
vocab.tip: 注意长音 /iː/，和第 1 单元 live /lɪv/ 区分。

vocab.why: 旅行时住在某处用 stay，长期居住用 live。
vocab.tip: Enjoy your stay! 是酒店前台常说的话。

vocab.why: How do you want to travel? ## 你想怎么去？
vocab.tip: 动词和名词同形。

vocab.why: Ask a local person. ## 问问当地人。
vocab.tip: 本地的。

ex: I need to reserve a room.
vocab.why: Reserve a parking spot online. ## 在网上预约停车位。
vocab.tip: 留着备用。

ex: Our tour guide is really funny.
vocab.why: The tour guide speaks Chinese. ## 导游会说中文。
vocab.tip: 带团游览的向导。

vocab.why: It was wonderful! ## 太精彩了！
vocab.tip: 充满惊奇的。

phrases.en: I want to go to San Francisco.
sim: I'd like to go to New York.
phrases.tip: want to + 动词原形。口语里常连读成 wanna。

sim: I need to check the weather.
I need to buy a ticket.
phrases.tip: need to 是需要，have to 是必须（更强）。

phrases.en: You have to see the Golden Gate Bridge!
phrases.zh: 你一定要去看金门大桥！
sim: I have to be back on Monday.
phrases.tip: 推荐好东西时用 You have to …，语气很热情。
复数用 How much are these?
美国商店常见的促销说法。

phrases.en: Sorry, can you say that again?
phrases.tip: 没听清千万别装懂，美国人对这句非常习惯。

sim: 抱歉，你家卫生间在哪儿？
phrases.tip: men's 和 women's 是所有格：男士的、女士的。
购物时决定买就说 I'll take it / I'll take two。

grammar.title: this / these 和 that / those
rows:
These birds are funny.
I don't like these pictures.

That's the restroom.
Those postcards are nice.
grammar.tip: this → these，that → those，后面的名词和动词也要跟着变复数。
grammar.say: This ticket is expensive. These postcards are two for five dollars.

grammar.title: like to / want to / need to / have to + 动词原形
rows:
We want to leave on Friday.
She wants to take a bus.
You need to check in two hours before the flight.

He has to buy tickets.
I have to be back on Monday.
grammar.tip: he / she 用 likes to、wants to、needs to、has to。to 后面一定是动词原形。
grammar.say: I like to fly, but I need to save money. He has to buy tickets.

pron.title: 价格的读法
pron.explain: 美国人说价格时，常常省掉 dollars 和 cents，直接读两组数字：12.99 读 twelve ninety-nine。点开听，再自己读一遍。
list: fifteen dollars（注意 -teen 重音在后）

readings.title: Travel guide: Places to go near San Francisco
readings.text: Golden Gate Bridge. Walk or ride a bike across this famous bridge. The views of the city and the ocean are wonderful. Muir Woods. This forest is about forty minutes north of the city. There are very tall, very old trees here. You need to reserve a parking spot, or you can take a shuttle bus. Sausalito. Take a boat from San Francisco to this small town. There are nice cafés and shops near the water. It's a great place for lunch.
readings.zh: 金门大桥：步行或骑车穿过这座著名的大桥，城市和海洋的景色美极了。缪尔森林：这片森林在市区以北约四十分钟车程，这里有非常高、非常古老的树。你需要提前预约停车位，或者坐接驳巴士。索萨利托：从旧金山坐船去这个小镇，水边有不错的咖啡馆和商店，是吃午饭的好地方。

grammarQuiz.why: tickets 是复数，用 these。
want to + 动词原形。

grammarQuiz.q: You have ___ check in two hours before the flight.
grammarQuiz.why: have to + 动词原形 = 必须。
he 用 has to。

writingTask.title: 写一段地点介绍：给游客的建议
writingTask.task: 给来你家乡旅游的人写一段介绍：可以去哪儿、做什么，给出一些建议。
writingTask.focus: 用祈使句给建议：Walk to the top of the hill. / Try the local food. / Don't miss …
starters: … is a great place to visit.
checklist: 至少用了三个祈使句
介绍了至少两个地方或活动
用了 need to / have to / want to 之一
句子清楚易懂
writingTask.model: Chengdu is a great place to visit. Go to the panda base in the morning. The pandas are very cute! Then take a walk in People's Park and drink some tea. Try the local food, but be careful. It's really spicy! You need to stay for three or four days.

units.title: Get ready
units.zh: 周末计划 · 衣服和季节
goals: 讨论不同旅行该穿什么
提议晚上的活动，接受或拒绝
说明自己为什么去不了

dialogues.title: A Beach Picnic
dialogues.zh: 艾玛约伟去海滩野餐
lines: What are you going to do this weekend?
I'm not sure. Are you going to be home?
还没想好。你周末在家吗？
No, I'm going to have a picnic at the beach with some friends. Do you want to come?
不在，我打算和几个朋友去海滩野餐。你想来吗？
Sure! What time are you going to leave?
At ten. It's going to be sunny and warm.
十点。那天会是晴天，很暖和。
Great. What do I need to take?
Take shorts, a T-shirt, and a hat. And a sweater for the evening. It's going to be cool.
带短裤、T 恤和帽子。再带件毛衣晚上穿，会有点凉。
OK. Are you going to swim?
Maybe. But the water is cold in spring!
也许吧。不过春天海水很冷！

dialogues.title: Why Don't We Go Out?
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯约伟吃晚饭
lines: Why don't we go out for dinner tonight?
Sorry, I can't. I have to work late.
抱歉，我去不了，我得加班。
Tomorrow is good. Where do you want to go?
Let's go to a taco place in East L.A.
我们去东洛杉矶的一家塔可店吧。
I'm sorry, but I can't. I have a call at seven. How about eight-thirty?
不好意思，七点不行，我七点有个电话。八点半怎么样？

ex: These boots are great for walking.
I need new boots for winter.
我冬天需要一双新靴子。
vocab.why: 电脑开机叫 boot up，来自一句俗语：拉着靴子带把自己提起来。
vocab.tip: 一双靴子：a pair of boots。

ex: My winter coat is in the closet.
我的冬季大衣在衣柜里。
vocab.why: raincoat 雨衣 = rain（雨）+ coat。
vocab.tip: 读 /koʊt/，和第 11 单元要学的 /oʊ/ 音一样，不要读成 cot。

vocab.why: She's wearing a red dress. ## 她穿着一条红裙子。
vocab.tip: 动词是穿衣服：get dressed。

vocab.why: 带檐的帽子叫 hat；棒球帽叫 cap。
vocab.tip: /æ/ 嘴张大：hat 不要读成 hot。

ex: Can I wear jeans to the party?
我能穿牛仔裤去派对吗？
vocab.why: 这种结实的布料最早产自意大利城市热那亚，法语叫 Gênes。
vocab.tip: 裤子总用复数：a pair of jeans，These jeans are…。

ex: I can take my winter pants.
vocab.why: These pants are new. ## 这条裤子是新的。
vocab.tip: 美国 pants 是长裤；英国 pants 是内裤，长裤叫 trousers。

vocab.why: He's wearing a white shirt. ## 他穿着白衬衫。
vocab.tip: T-shirt = T 恤。

ex: These shoes are great for walking.
vocab.why: Take off your shoes. ## 把鞋脱了。
vocab.tip: 一双鞋：a pair of shoes。

ex: My shorts are in my bag.
vocab.why: 短的裤子。英语里裤子类的词都用复数：pants、jeans、shorts。
vocab.tip: 美国说 pants 是长裤，英国说 pants 是内裤，要注意。

vocab.why: I like your skirt. ## 我喜欢你的裙子。
vocab.tip: 和 shirt 同源。

ex: Take a sweater for the evening.
Are you going to take some sweaters?
vocab.why: 最早是运动员穿着出汗用的厚衣服，后来泛指毛衣。
vocab.tip: ea 读短音 /e/：/ˈswetər/。

ex: 这件 T 恤是芝加哥买的。
Take a T-shirt and a hat.
带件 T 恤和帽子。
vocab.why: 平铺开来的形状像字母 T。
vocab.tip: shirt 读 /ʃɝːt/，卷舌。

vocab.why: It doesn't rain in the dry season. ## 旱季不下雨。
vocab.tip: 热带地区分旱季和雨季。

ex: The leaves are red in the fall.
vocab.why: 秋天树叶落下（the fall of the leaves），所以美国人把秋天叫 fall。
vocab.tip: 美国日常说 fall，英国说 autumn。

ex: Let's talk about the rainy season.
vocab.why: It rains every day in the rainy season. ## 雨季每天下雨。
vocab.tip: 下雨多的季节。

ex: The water is cold in spring!
vocab.why: I love spring. ## 我喜欢春天。
vocab.tip: 万物生长涌出的季节。也有弹簧、泉水的意思。

ex: We go to the beach in the summer.
Summer vacation is long in the U.S.
vocab.why: 四季：spring（春）、summer（夏）、fall（秋）、winter（冬）。
vocab.tip: 季节前用 in：in summer / in the summer。

ex: I can take my winter pants.
vocab.why: 美国人说的 winter break 是寒假。
vocab.tip: 美国人常把中间的 t 弱化，听起来像 winner。

ex: They're not going to eat outside this weekend.
他们这周末不打算在外面吃饭。
vocab.why: Let's eat outside. It's sunny. ## 我们在外面吃吧，天晴着呢。
vocab.tip: 在户外吃。

ex: We're going to get together with some friends.
我们要和几个朋友聚一下。
vocab.why: 变得在一起，就是聚会。名词 get-together 是小型聚会。
vocab.tip: 名词形式加连字符：a get-together。

ex: Let's go shopping at the mall.
vocab.why: My friends aren't going to go shopping. ## 我朋友们不打算去购物。
vocab.tip: go + 动词-ing 表示去做某种活动：go swimming。

ex: Let's have a picnic in the park.
We're going to have a picnic at the beach.
It's a great day for a picnic.
vocab.why: 来自法语 pique-nique，原指每人带一点吃的、一起分享的聚餐。
vocab.tip: 野餐：have a picnic（不说 do a picnic）。

ex: Let's look at art in the museum.
我们去博物馆看艺术品吧。
vocab.why: I love to look at art. ## 我喜欢看艺术品。
vocab.tip: 看某物用 look at。

ex: You're going to meet me at the airport.
vocab.why: Can you meet me at the airport? ## 你能来机场接我吗？
vocab.tip: 接机用 meet 或 pick up。

ex: Let's take a walk in the park.
vocab.why: I take a walk after dinner. ## 我晚饭后散步。
vocab.tip: 名词 walk 前用 take。

ex: I want to take my mom out for dinner.
我想请我妈妈出去吃饭。
vocab.why: Let's take Emma out for dinner. ## 我们请艾玛出去吃饭吧。
vocab.tip: 通常表示请客。

ex: It's going to be light all night.
vocab.why: These earphones are light. ## 这副耳机很轻。
vocab.tip: 有亮和轻两个意思。

ex: Let's get up for the sunrise.
vocab.why: The sunrise is beautiful. ## 日出很美。
vocab.tip: 太阳升起。

vocab.why: What a surprise! ## 真是个惊喜！
vocab.tip: 突然被抓住，就是吃惊。

phrases.en: What are you going to do this weekend?
phrases.reply: I'm going to have a picnic.
phrases.tip: 周五美国同事之间最常问的一句。

phrases.en: I'm going to have a picnic.
phrases.tip: 口语里 going to 常读成 gonna。

phrases.en: Why don't we go out tonight?
phrases.tip: Why don't we …? 不是问原因，是委婉地提议。

sim: Where do you want to meet?
phrases.tip: 见面地点用 at，时间也用 at。
接受建议最常用的说法。
拒绝时最好加一句原因，显得更礼貌。
拒绝后马上提出新时间，对话就不会冷场。
Don't + 动词原形 = 不要做某事。

grammar.title: be going to：陈述句
rows:
I'm going to be home tomorrow.
We're going to get together with some friends.

I'm not going to be home tonight.
It isn't going to rain.

It's going to be sunny.
It's going to be cool.
grammar.tip: be going to + 动词原形，表示已经打算好的计划，或根据现在的情况做出的预测。
grammar.say: I'm going to have a picnic. It's going to be sunny.

grammar.title: be going to：疑问句
rows:
Are you going to take some sweaters?
Is Sofia going to see a friend?

Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.
Yes, she is. / No, she's not.

What are you going to take?
When are you going to leave?
Who are you going to meet?
grammar.tip: 把 am / is / are 提到主语前面。
grammar.say: What are you going to do this weekend? Are you going to swim?

pron.title: 字母 s 的两种读音：/s/ 和 /z/
pron.explain: 字母 s 有时读清音 /s/（嗓子不振动），有时读浊音 /z/（嗓子振动，摸喉咙能感觉到）。复数 shoes、jeans、clothes 结尾都读 /z/，shirts、hats 结尾读 /s/。

readings.title: Invitation: Beach picnic
readings.text: You're invited! Beach picnic for Emma's new job. When: Saturday, June fourteenth, eleven a.m. to four p.m. Where: Santa Monica Beach, near the pier. We're going to eat sandwiches and fruit, play volleyball, and watch the sunset. Bring a hat, a towel, and a sweater for the evening. It's going to be cool. Please don't bring glass bottles. Reply by Thursday! Carlos
readings.zh: 诚邀你参加！为庆祝艾玛的新工作，举办海滩野餐。时间：6 月 14 日周六，上午 11 点到下午 4 点。地点：圣莫尼卡海滩，靠近码头。我们要吃三明治和水果、打排球、看日落。请带帽子、毛巾和一件晚上穿的毛衣，会有点凉。请不要带玻璃瓶。周四前回复！——卡洛斯

grammarQuiz.why: be going to + 动词原形。

grammarQuiz.q: ___ you going to take a sweater?
grammarQuiz.why: you 用 are，疑问句把 are 提前。
it 的否定用 isn't。
she 用 is。

writingTask.title: 写一份活动邀请
writingTask.task: 邀请朋友参加一个周末活动：什么活动、什么时间、在哪里、要做什么、要带什么。
writingTask.focus: 缩写：邀请函语气轻松，多用 we're、it's、don't、you're 这样的缩写。
checklist: 写了时间和地点
用 be going to 说了计划
至少用了三个缩写（we're、it's、don't 等）
说了要带什么
writingTask.model: You're invited! It's Carlos's birthday, and we're going to have a picnic in the park. When: Sunday, 12:00 to 4:00. Where: Griffith Park, near the zoo. We're going to eat tacos and play soccer. Bring a hat. It's going to be sunny! Don't tell Carlos. It's a surprise!

units.title: Colorful memories
goals: 描述过去的人、地点和东西
写一封关于旧物的邮件
表达不确定、争取思考时间

dialogues.title: Old Photos
dialogues.zh: 艾玛看伟小时候的照片
lines: Yes, it is. I was six.
You were so cute! Where were you?
I was in my grandparents' yard in Chengdu.
在成都我爷爷奶奶家的院子里。
No, they weren't. They were at work.
And what's this? Was it your toy?
这是什么？是你的玩具吗？
Yes! It was my favorite toy, a red car.
对！那是我最喜欢的玩具，一辆红色小汽车。
你的卧室是什么颜色的？
Hmm, let me think. It was blue, I think. Yes, blue and white.
嗯，让我想想。好像是蓝色的。对，蓝白色。

dialogues.title: A Movie from the Nineties
dialogues.zh: 卡洛斯和伟聊一部老电影
lines: Do you remember that movie about a big ship? It was really popular.
你记得那部讲大船的电影吗？当年特别火。
Who was the actor? I have no idea.
男主角是谁来着？我完全想不起来了。
Um, I'm not sure. His first name was Leonardo, I think.
嗯，我不太确定。他的名字好像是莱昂纳多。
哦，对！莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥。
It was wonderful, but it was very sad.
Were you in a movie theater?
Yes, I was. I was with my sister. We were both in tears!
是啊，和我姐姐一起，我们俩都哭了！

vocab.why: My phone is black. ## 我的手机是黑色的。
vocab.tip: 和 blank（空白）不同。

vocab.why: I love the blue ocean. ## 我喜欢蓝色的大海。
vocab.tip: feel blue 是心情低落。

vocab.why: He has brown eyes. ## 他是棕色的眼睛。
vocab.tip: ow 读 /aʊ/。

vocab.why: The sky is gray today. ## 今天天空灰蒙蒙的。
vocab.tip: 美式 gray，英式 grey。

ex: 那部绿色的手机在哪儿？
vocab.why: The walls were pink and green. ## 墙是粉色和绿色的。
vocab.tip: 和 grass、grow 同源。

vocab.why: I'd like an orange juice. ## 我要一杯橙汁。
vocab.tip: 先有水果，后来才有颜色名。

vocab.why: She loves pink. ## 她喜欢粉色。
vocab.tip: 短音 /ɪ/。

vocab.why: Purple is my favorite color. ## 紫色是我最喜欢的颜色。
vocab.tip: 来自古代昂贵的紫色染料，曾是皇室专用色。

ex: It was my favorite toy, a red car.
那是我最喜欢的玩具，一辆红色小汽车。
vocab.why: I like your red dress. ## 我喜欢你的红裙子。
vocab.tip: 过去式 read 也读 /red/。

vocab.why: The walls are white. ## 墙是白色的。
vocab.tip: h 不发音：/waɪt/。

vocab.why: I have a yellow T-shirt. ## 我有件黄色 T 恤。
vocab.tip: 和 gold（金）同源。

vocab.why: 本义是令人敬畏的，后来意思变成了糟糕的、可怕的。awesome（很棒的）也来自 awe，意思却变成了好的。
vocab.tip: awful 是坏，awesome 是好，别搞反了。

vocab.why: 充满美的。y 变 i 再加 -ful。wonderful、colorful 也是 -ful。
vocab.tip: -ful 后缀只有一个 l。

vocab.why: 最早是 acute（敏锐的）的缩写，后来在美国英语里变成可爱的意思。
vocab.tip: 夸小孩、小动物最常用 cute。

ex: It was a very exciting day.
那是非常令人兴奋的一天。
vocab.why: -ing 说事情让人怎样，-ed 说人感觉怎样：The movie was exciting. I was excited.
rel: 无聊的 / 感到无聊的
vocab.tip: 和第 5 单元的 tired / tiring 是同一个规律。

vocab.why: He runs fast. ## 他跑得快。
vocab.tip: 副词也是 fast，不加 -ly。

vocab.why: I have a new phone. ## 我有部新手机。
vocab.tip: 美式读 /nuː/，英式读 /njuː/。

vocab.why: 去掉 e 加 -y：noise → noisy。
vocab.tip: 反义词 quiet。

vocab.why: 注意和 quite（相当）区分：quiet 两个音节 /ˈkwaɪət/，quite 一个音节 /kwaɪt/。
vocab.tip: Be quiet! 比较直接，客气一点说 Could you be a little quieter?

vocab.why: This computer is slow. ## 这台电脑很慢。
vocab.tip: 副词 slowly。

vocab.why: It was wonderful! ## 太精彩了！
vocab.tip: 充满惊奇的。

ex: I remember my first day at school.
我记得我上学的第一天。
vocab.why: I remember, it was a red car. ## 我记得，是一辆红色小汽车。
vocab.tip: 用来引出回忆。

vocab.why: He's a famous actor. ## 他是个著名演员。
vocab.tip: 表演的人。

vocab.why: I have a famous singer's autograph. ## 我有一位著名歌手的签名。
vocab.tip: 自己亲手写的。

ex: I remember a lot from my childhood.
It was my favorite TV show in my childhood.
那是我童年最喜欢的电视节目。
vocab.why: 和第 6 单元的 neighborhood 一样用 -hood 结尾，这里表示时期。
vocab.tip: child 读 /tʃaɪld/，children 读 /ˈtʃɪldrən/，元音不一样。

ex: Do you keep things from your past?
你会保留过去的东西吗？
vocab.why: I keep my old photos. ## 我留着旧照片。
vocab.tip: 过去式 kept。

ex: I have a lot of happy memories.
This photo is full of memories.
My grandmother has a great memory.
vocab.why: memo（备忘录）、memorial（纪念的）都来自同一个词根。
vocab.tip: 复数 memories：y 变 i 加 es。

ex: I remember my first day at school.
我记得我上学的第一天。
vocab.why: 再一次记起来，就是记得、回想。memory（记忆）也来自 memor。
vocab.tip: 反义：forget（忘记）。

vocab.why: It's not ugly. It's cute! ## 不丑，挺可爱的！
vocab.tip: 反义词 beautiful。

ex: Our house has a big yard.
The kids are playing in the yard.
vocab.why: 美国房子前后的空地：front yard（前院）、backyard（后院）。
vocab.tip: 美国说 yard，英国常说 garden。

phrases.tip: 说过去的年龄用 was。

phrases.reply: I was in my grandparents' yard.
phrases.tip: you 的过去式用 were。

phrases.en: Were your parents there? — No, they weren't.
phrases.tip: 否定缩写：wasn't = was not，weren't = were not。
非常不确定时用。
比 I don't know 更委婉。
需要时间组织语言时说这句，比沉默好得多。
把 I think 放在句尾，表示有点不确定。
聊共同回忆的好开头。

grammar.title: was / were：陈述句
rows:
I was in the yard.
It was my favorite toy.

We were on vacation.
They were at work.

My parents weren't there.
It wasn't old.
grammar.tip: am / is 的过去式是 was，are 的过去式是 were。I、he、she、it 用 was；you、we、they 用 were。
grammar.say: I was six. My parents weren't there. They were at work.

grammar.title: was / were：疑问句
rows:
Were you at home?
Was the phone in the kitchen?

No, I wasn't.
Yes, it was.

How old were you? — I was two.
What color were the walls? — They were orange.
grammar.tip: 把 was / were 提到主语前面。
grammar.say: Were you at home? No, I wasn't. What color were the walls? They were orange.

pron.title: /oʊ/ 和 /ɑː/
pron.explain: /oʊ/ 是滑动的双元音，从 o 滑到 u，像 go；/ɑː/ 嘴巴张大、不滑动，像 hot。美国英语里 not、hot、got 都读 /ɑː/，不是中文的 o。

readings.title: Things we keep
readings.text: Do you keep things from your past? A lot of people do. Lisa, thirty-five, keeps her old blue phone. It was her first cell phone. It doesn't work now, but she loves it. Ben, sixty-two, keeps a ticket from a baseball game. He was ten, and he was at the game with his father. It was a very exciting day. Amy, twenty-eight, keeps a small brown bear. It was a present from her grandmother. These things are not expensive, but they're full of memories.
readings.zh: 你会保留过去的东西吗？很多人都会。丽莎，三十五岁，留着她那部旧的蓝色手机，那是她的第一部手机，现在已经不能用了，但她很喜欢。本，六十二岁，留着一张棒球比赛的门票，那年他十岁，和爸爸一起去看的比赛，那是非常激动的一天。艾米，二十八岁，留着一只棕色的小熊，那是奶奶送她的礼物。这些东西都不贵，却满载着回忆。

grammarQuiz.why: I 的过去式用 was。
parents 是复数，用 were。
walls 是复数，用 were。
it 的过去否定是 wasn't。

writingTask.title: 给朋友写一封邮件：你留着的旧东西
writingTask.task: 给朋友写一封邮件，说说你保留着的一样旧东西：是什么、是哪儿来的、那时候你几岁、为什么留着它。
writingTask.focus: 段落和主题句：每段开头一句话说清这段的主题，再展开。
checklist: 分了至少两段
每段第一句是主题句
用了 was / were 讲过去
说了为什么留着它
writingTask.model:
Hi Emma,
I still have my first toy. It's a small red car. It was a present from my grandfather. I was five, and we were in his yard in Chengdu.
I keep it because it's full of memories. My grandfather was very funny, and that day was wonderful. Do you keep things from your childhood?
Wei

units.title: Stop, eat, go
units.zh: 餐厅点餐 · 一般过去时
goals: 请人吃喝、接受别人的招待
用 so 和 really 加强语气

dialogues.title: At a Diner
dialogues.zh: 伟在美式小餐馆点餐
lines: Hi there! What would you like to drink?
Of course. We have small and large.
A large iced tea, please. It's so hot today.
大杯冰茶，谢谢。今天太热了。
Here you are. Are you ready to order?
Yes. I'd like the chicken and rice, please.
Would you like soup or salad with that?
好的。（饭后）一切还满意吗？
It was really good. Can I have the check, please?
非常好吃。能给我账单吗？

dialogues.title: Dinner at Linda's
dialogues.zh: 伟在房东琳达家吃晚饭
lines: Wei, would you like some more potatoes?
Here you go. Did you eat lunch today?
给你。你今天吃午饭了吗？
No, I didn't. I was very busy. I only had a sandwich for breakfast.
没吃，太忙了。我早饭只吃了个三明治。
Oh, no. You're hungry! Jake, please pass the bread to Wei.
哎呀，你饿坏了！杰克，把面包递给伟。
Thanks. Linda, did you make this cake?
谢谢。琳达，这个蛋糕是你做的吗？
Yes, I did. Do you want some?

vocab.why: I have bread and butter. ## 我吃面包抹黄油。
vocab.tip: 不可数。

ex: Do you want cheese on that?
这奶酪产自威斯康星州。
vocab.why: 西班牙语的 queso（奶酪）也来自拉丁语 caseus。
vocab.tip: 拍照时美国人说 Say cheese!

ex: We had chocolate cake for dessert.
我们甜点吃了巧克力蛋糕。
vocab.why: I love chocolate cake. ## 我爱吃巧克力蛋糕。
vocab.tip: chocolate 来自墨西哥阿兹特克语。

ex: I have coffee and a cookie every afternoon.
我每天下午喝咖啡吃块饼干。
vocab.why: 来自荷兰语 koekje，意思是小蛋糕。美国早期的荷兰移民把这个词带到了美国。
vocab.tip: 美国说 cookie，英国说 biscuit；网站上的 cookie 是浏览记录小文件。

ex: Did they eat any ice cream?
Let's get ice cream after dinner.
vocab.why: 冰冻的奶油。
vocab.tip: 两个词分开写：ice cream。

vocab.why: 加 -y 变 juicy（多汁的）。
vocab.tip: ui 读 /uː/：/dʒuːs/。

vocab.why: Refills on soda are free. ## 汽水免费续杯。
vocab.tip: 美国很多地方叫 soda，有些地区叫 pop。

vocab.why: There's a lot of water in the ocean. ## 海里有大量的水。
vocab.tip: 不可数。美国餐厅免费提供冰水。

vocab.why: Did you have apple juice? ## 你喝苹果汁了吗？
vocab.tip: 元音开头用 an：an apple。

ex: I have a banana for breakfast.
vocab.why: Bananas are cheap here. ## 这里香蕉很便宜。
vocab.tip: 来自西非语言，经葡萄牙语传入。

ex: I'd like rice and black beans.
vocab.why: Black beans are popular in Mexican food. ## 黑豆在墨西哥菜里很常见。
vocab.tip: 拉美菜常见。

vocab.why: There are coconuts on the island. ## 岛上有椰子。
vocab.tip: 椰子壳上的三个小坑像一张脸。

ex: I had green beans and chicken.
vocab.why: My kids don't like green beans. ## 我的孩子不爱吃四季豆。
vocab.tip: 绿色的豆荚。

vocab.why: I'd like an orange juice. ## 我要一杯橙汁。
vocab.tip: 先有水果，后来才有颜色名。

vocab.why: I'd like pineapple juice. ## 我要菠萝汁。
vocab.tip: 长得像松果的果子。

vocab.why: I love potatoes. ## 我爱吃土豆。
vocab.tip: 复数加 es：potatoes。

vocab.why: There are tomatoes in the salad. ## 沙拉里有西红柿。
vocab.tip: 来自墨西哥的阿兹特克语。

ex: I have bread and butter for breakfast.
vocab.why: bread 不可数：some bread、a piece of bread，不说 a bread。
vocab.tip: ea 读短音 /e/：/bred/，和 bed 押韵。

vocab.why: Do you want some crackers? ## 要点饼干吗？
vocab.tip: 咬下去咔嚓响。

ex: Do you want rice or bread?
vocab.why: rice 不可数：some rice，a bowl of rice（一碗饭）。
vocab.tip: r 和 l 别混：rice 是米，lice 是虱子。

vocab.why: 有个有趣的规律：活的动物用英语本土词（cow、pig），端上餐桌的肉用法语来源的词（beef、pork）。
vocab.tip: /iː/ 是长音。

ex: I'd like the chicken and rice, please.
vocab.why: 小鸡是 chick。当食物讲时 chicken 不可数：some chicken。
vocab.tip: /ɪ/ 是短音：/ˈtʃɪkɪn/，不读 chee-ken。

vocab.why: Two eggs, please. ## 来两个鸡蛋。
vocab.tip: 元音开头：an egg。

vocab.why: I really like this fish. ## 我真喜欢这道鱼。
vocab.tip: 复数常和单数一样：two fish。

vocab.why: I don't eat lamb. ## 我不吃羊肉。
vocab.tip: b 不发音：/læm/。

vocab.why: I'd like a slice of pizza. ## 我要一块披萨。
vocab.tip: zz 读 /ts/。

vocab.why: How do you want your steak? ## 牛排要几分熟？
vocab.tip: ea 读 /eɪ/，和 stake 同音。

ex: I only had a sandwich for breakfast.
我早饭只吃了个三明治。
Let's get sandwiches for the picnic.
我们给野餐买些三明治吧。
parts: 桑威奇伯爵（英国贵族头衔）
vocab.why: 据说以英国的桑威奇伯爵命名，他喜欢把肉夹在面包里吃。
vocab.tip: d 一般不发音：/ˈsænwɪtʃ/。

ex: Would you like soup or salad?
I had some soup for lunch.
vocab.why: 英语说喝汤用 eat soup 或 have soup，较少说 drink soup。
vocab.tip: ou 读 /uː/。

ex: 我们的服务员来自墨西哥。
Excuse me, can I talk to our server?
不好意思，能叫一下我们的服务员吗？
vocab.why: -er 是最常见的人后缀：serve → server，teach → teacher，drive → driver。
vocab.tip: 美国餐厅里 server 比 waiter / waitress 更常用，不分男女。

vocab.why: Excuse me, waiter! ## 服务员！
vocab.tip: 等着为你服务的人。

vocab.why: She's a waitress at a diner. ## 她在小餐馆当服务员。
vocab.tip: -ress 表示女性。

ex: Let's get tacos at that food stand.
我们在那个小吃摊买塔可吧。
vocab.why: There are food stands at the beach. ## 海边有小吃摊。
vocab.tip: 路边卖吃的小摊。

vocab.why: hunger 去掉 e 加 -y。
vocab.tip: 吃饱了说 I'm full.

ex: I drink iced tea in the summer.
vocab.why: 加了冰的茶。注意是 iced，不是 ice tea（虽然口语里 d 常常听不出来）。
vocab.tip: 很多美国餐厅的冰茶默认不加糖，可以免费续杯。

vocab.why: Would you like more potatoes? ## 再来点土豆吗？
vocab.tip: some more 表示再来一些。

phrases.en: What would you like to drink?
sim: What would you like to eat?
phrases.tip: 服务员的标准问法，would you like 比 do you want 更礼貌。

phrases.en: I'd like the chicken and rice, please.
phrases.tip: I'd = I would。点菜单上的菜用 the。

sim: Do you have a menu in Chinese?
phrases.tip: 不确定有没有时先问一句。

sim: Can I have the check, please?
phrases.tip: 在餐厅结账说 Can I have the check?，美国用 check，不说 bill。
在美国家里吃饭，够不着的东西不要伸手越过别人去拿，请人递过来更礼貌。
回应别人的请求时用。

phrases.en: Would you like some more? — Yes, please.
phrases.tip: 吃饱了就说 No, thanks. I'm full. 并夸一句 It was delicious!
so 和 really 让语气更强；吃别人家的饭一定要夸一夸。

grammar.title: 一般过去时：陈述句
rows:
want → wanted, like → liked
She wanted an orange.

have → had, eat → ate, take → took, go → went
I had some soup.

I didn't eat a lot for breakfast.
They didn't drink the coffee.
grammar.tip: 否定用 didn't + 动词原形：I didn't eat，不说 I didn't ate。不规则动词要单独记，可以查不规则动词表。
grammar.say: Yesterday, I had some soup. I didn't eat a lot for breakfast.

grammar.title: 一般过去时：疑问句和 any
rows:
Did you have apple juice?
Did she like the fish?
Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

Did they eat any ice cream?
We didn't have any bread.

What did they eat?
How did you hear about us?
grammar.tip: 疑问句用 did + 动词原形。any 用在疑问句和否定句里，表示任何、一点。
grammar.say: Did you have lunch? No, I didn't. What did you eat?

pron.title: /h/ 和 /r/
pron.explain: /h/ 只是轻轻呼一口气，喉咙不摩擦，比中文的 h 轻很多；/r/ 舌尖往后卷，但不碰上颚，嘴唇稍微收圆。hungry、hot、have 开头都是很轻的 /h/。

readings.title: Review: Rosa's Kitchen
readings.text: Four stars. Last Friday, my family and I had dinner at Rosa's Kitchen in Pasadena. I had the chicken and rice, and it was so good. My brother had a steak. He really liked it. My mom didn't like her fish very much. It was OK, but not great. For dessert, we had chocolate cake and ice cream. The servers were really friendly, and the price was OK, not cheap but not expensive. We were happy with our meal.
readings.zh: 四星。上周五，我和家人在帕萨迪纳的罗莎厨房吃了晚饭。我点了鸡肉配米饭，太好吃了。我哥哥点了牛排，他非常喜欢。我妈妈不太喜欢她的鱼，还行，但不算好。甜点我们吃了巧克力蛋糕和冰淇淋。服务员非常友好，价格也还可以，不便宜但也不贵。这顿饭我们很满意。

grammarQuiz.why: have 的过去式是不规则的 had。
过去时的一般疑问句用 Did + 动词原形。
didn't 后面用动词原形。
ice cream 不可数，疑问句用 any。

writingTask.title: 写一篇餐厅点评
writingTask.task: 写一篇你最近去过的一家餐厅的点评：你吃了什么、同伴吃了什么、味道怎么样、服务和价格如何。
writingTask.focus: 列举时用逗号：We had chicken, rice, and soup.（最后一项前加 and）
checklist: 用了一般过去时（had、was、liked）
列举时用了逗号和 and
评价了食物、服务和价格
用了 so 或 really 加强语气
writingTask.model: Last Friday, I had dinner at Rosa's Kitchen with Emma and Carlos. I had the chicken and rice, and it was so good. Emma had fish, salad, and soup. Carlos had a big steak. The servers were really friendly. The price was OK, not cheap but not expensive. Four stars!

gloss.name: 名字
gloss.pasadena: 帕萨迪纳（洛杉矶附近的城市）
gloss.sausalito: 索萨利托（旧金山附近小镇）
